description: Runtime behaviour profiler daemon. Reads mesh_events for MCP-related events via ws_query WHERE event_type IN (assessment_requested, mcp_tool_called, mcp_verdict_update) AND created_at > now()-24h. Profile per server_id: call_frequency (calls/hour), unique_callers, time_of_day_distribution (suspicious if only 2-4am calls), payload_size_variance (consistent large payloads = data exfiltration signal). Anomaly detection: call_frequency > 100/hr = rate_abuse, only_after_hours_calls (>90% between 0:00-6:00 UTC) = evasion_pattern, payload_size > 10x median = bulk_exfiltration_attempt. ws_write mcp_threat_associations for each anomaly. ws_write mcp_signal_scores temporal_stability and community_signal updates. Write BEHAVIOUR_PROFILE.md. Poll 3600s. Heartbeat.
